description: Purchase a catalog item and place it at (x,y,level) facing dir. Transaction is verified server-side: price debited via GlobalLink.PerformTransaction, then Verified=true, then re-applied on the lot's VM. Prerequisite: you must be the lot owner (handler-side gate via VMTSOLotState.OwnerID; server-side gate via PlatformState.Validator.GetPurchaseMode returning >= BuildBuyRoommate). Lot must not be full. Cost: the catalog price (with build-mode discount applied by server) from your budget; refunded by the server if placement fails. Effect: a new object appears in nearby_objects at (x,y,level); your balance (query-self.balance) drops by the net price. Mode=Donate (visitor-placed donation) reduces net cost to 1/3 of Normal but requires CanPlaceNewDonatedObject permission. OQ-8 note: there is no 'enter build mode' PDU — gating is per-command inside VMNetBuyObjectCmd.Verify; if you lack permission the command is silently dropped (no error, no effect). Wire: VMNetBuyObjectCmd on the lot Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF buy-object --guid <catalog_guid> --x <subtile_x> --y <subtile_y>              # owner-only; x/y in 1/16-tile units (tile*16)
cf $CF buy-object --guid <guid> --x <x> --y <y> --level 2 --dir 192 --mode Normal    # upper floor, NW-facing; mode=Normal|Donate
common_mistakes: Calling as non-owner → handler ok:false (server would also silently drop).
guid=0 or missing → ok:false; x/y missing → ok:false.
x/y are SUBTILE coords (1/16 tile units) — tile 10 is x=160. Easy off-by-16x bug.
Non-whitelisted category (only 12..20 allowed for roommate buyers per RoomieWhiteList) — server silently drops; use find-cheap-catalog-guid to pick safe items.
perception_hints: Your balance (can you afford the object?): perception.balance
Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — owner-only ops refuse otherwise
Free tile to place on: inspect perception.nearby_objects[] to find unoccupied tiles; positions are in tile coords, multiply by 16 for subtile x/y
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner (for buy/move/delete/place-from-inventory) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
caller is not object owner (for send-to-inventory/list-for-sale/upgrade) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not the object owner (object_owner=..., me=...)'
required args missing (guid, x, y, target_object_id, target_object_persist_id) → returns ok:false with specific missing-arg error
